comment: A design for tools/ui-scripts/sketch-show-unconstrained.mitcad-ui (mitcad#2026): Sketch1 (F1) on XY with two lines joined at (20, 0), their three points fixed, so that both are fully constrained, and a free line from (0, 10) to (10, 10): the only curve and the only two points that are not fully constrained (4 degrees of freedom).
